!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = Fresh tissue obtained at the time of surgery was trimmed to remove extraneous tissue. Cells were dispersed using enzyme-based protocols optimized for each tissue type. The resulting single-cell suspension was incubated with the relevant antibodies and FACS sorted to obtain the desired cell type. Purity of live sorted cells was determined by mRNA analysis for key known cell-type specific genes whereas purity of cells that were fixed prior to sorting was determined using previously validated cell-type specific methylation signals
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = genomic DNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = DNA was extracted using the DNeasy Blood and Tissue kit (#69504 Qiagen; Germantown, MD) according to the manufacturerâs instructions, and stored at -20Â°C for bisulfite conversion and whole genome sequencing.
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.
!Sample_data_processing = Paired-end FASTQ files were mapped to the human (hg19 -or- hg38), lambda, pUC19 and viral genomes using bwa-meth (V 0.2.0), with default parameters (Pedersen et al., 2014), then converted to BAM files using SAMtools (V 1.9) (Li et al., 2009).
!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were stripped from non-CpG nucleotides and converted to BETA files using wgbstools (V 0.2.0) (Loyfer and Kaplan).
!Sample_data_processing = Genome_build: hg19
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary_files_format_and_content:
!Sample_data_processing = beta files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = bigwig files were generated from beta files using wgbstools beta2bw with default parameteres

!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = DNA was extracted using the DNeasy Blood and Tissue kit (#69504 Qiagen; Germantown, MD) according to the manufacturerâs instructions, and stored at -20Â°C for bisulfite conversion and whole genome sequencing.
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.
!Sample_data_processing = Paired-end FASTQ files were mapped to the human (hg19 -or- hg38), lambda, pUC19 and viral genomes using bwa-meth (V 0.2.0), with default parameters (Pedersen et al., 2014), then converted to BAM files using SAMtools (V 1.9) (Li et al., 2009).
!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were stripped from non-CpG nucleotides and converted to BETA files using wgbstools (V 0.2.0) (Loyfer and Kaplan).

The resulting single-cell suspension was incubated with the relevant antibodies and FACS sorted to obtain the desired cell type. Purity of live sorted cells was determined by mRNA analysis for key known cell-type specific genes whereas purity of cells that were fixed prior to sorting was determined using previously validated cell-type specific methylation signals

!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.

!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.

!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = Fresh tissue obtained at the time of surgery was trimmed to remove extraneous tissue. Cells were dispersed using enzyme-based protocols optimized for each tissue type. The resulting single-cell suspension was incubated with the relevant antibodies and FACS sorted to obtain the desired cell type. Purity of live sorted cells was determined by mRNA analysis for key known cell-type specific genes whereas purity of cells that were fixed prior to sorting was determined using previously validated cell-type specific methylation signals
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = genomic DNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = DNA was extracted using the DNeasy Blood and Tissue kit (#69504 Qiagen; Germantown, MD) according to the manufacturerâs instructions, and stored at -20Â°C for bisulfite conversion and whole genome sequencing.
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.
!Sample_data_processing = Paired-end FASTQ files were mapped to the human (hg19 -or- hg38), lambda, pUC19 and viral genomes using bwa-meth (V 0.2.0), with default parameters (Pedersen et al., 2014), then converted to BAM files using SAMtools (V 1.9) (Li et al., 2009).
!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were stripped from non-CpG nucleotides and converted to BETA files using wgbstools (V 0.2.0) (Loyfer and Kaplan).

!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = Fresh tissue obtained at the time of surgery was trimmed to remove extraneous tissue. Cells were dispersed using enzyme-based protocols optimized for each tissue type. The resulting single-cell suspension was incubated with the relevant antibodies and FACS sorted to obtain the desired cell type. Purity of live sorted cells was determined by mRNA analysis for key known cell-type specific genes whereas purity of cells that were fixed prior to sorting was determined using previously validated cell-type specific methylation signals
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = genomic DNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = DNA was extracted using the DNeasy Blood and Tissue kit (#69504 Qiagen; Germantown, MD) according to the manufacturerâs instructions, and stored at -20Â°C for bisulfite conversion and whole genome sequencing.
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.
!Sample_data_processing = Paired-end FASTQ files were mapped to the human (hg19 -or- hg38), lambda, pUC19 and viral genomes using bwa-meth (V 0.2.0), with default parameters (Pedersen et al., 2014), then converted to BAM files using SAMtools (V 1.9) (Li et al., 2009).
!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were stripped from non-CpG nucleotides and converted to BETA files using wgbstools (V 0.2.0) (Loyfer and Kaplan).
!Sample_data_processing = Genome_build: hg19
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary_files_format_and_content:
!Sample_data_processing = beta files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = bigwig files were generated from beta files using wgbstools beta2bw with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = blocks file (bed) was generated using wgbstools segment, and then compressed and indexed using tabix (samtools)

!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.
!Sample_data_processing = Paired-end FASTQ files were mapped to the human (hg19 -or- hg38), lambda, pUC19 and viral genomes using bwa-meth (V 0.2.0), with default parameters (Pedersen et al., 2014), then converted to BAM files using SAMtools (V 1.9) (Li et al., 2009).
!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were stripped from non-CpG nucleotides and converted to BETA files using wgbstools (V 0.2.0) (Loyfer and Kaplan).

Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.

!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = Fresh tissue obtained at the time of surgery was trimmed to remove extraneous tissue. Cells were dispersed using enzyme-based protocols optimized for each tissue type. The resulting single-cell suspension was incubated with the relevant antibodies and FACS sorted to obtain the desired cell type. Purity of live sorted cells was determined by mRNA analysis for key known cell-type specific genes whereas purity of cells that were fixed prior to sorting was determined using previously validated cell-type specific methylation signals
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = genomic DNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = DNA was extracted using the DNeasy Blood and Tissue kit (#69504 Qiagen; Germantown, MD) according to the manufacturerâs instructions, and stored at -20Â°C for bisulfite conversion and whole genome sequencing.
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.
!Sample_data_processing = Paired-end FASTQ files were mapped to the human (hg19 -or- hg38), lambda, pUC19 and viral genomes using bwa-meth (V 0.2.0), with default parameters (Pedersen et al., 2014), then converted to BAM files using SAMtools (V 1.9) (Li et al., 2009).
!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were stripped from non-CpG nucleotides and converted to BETA files using wgbstools (V 0.2.0) (Loyfer and Kaplan).
!Sample_data_processing = Genome_build: hg19
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary_files_format_and_content:
!Sample_data_processing = beta files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = bigwig files were generated from beta files using wgbstools beta2bw with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = blocks file (bed) was generated using wgbstools segment, and then compressed and indexed using tabix (samtools)

!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.

!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.

!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = Fresh tissue obtained at the time of surgery was trimmed to remove extraneous tissue. Cells were dispersed using enzyme-based protocols optimized for each tissue type. The resulting single-cell suspension was incubated with the relevant antibodies and FACS sorted to obtain the desired cell type. Purity of live sorted cells was determined by mRNA analysis for key known cell-type specific genes whereas purity of cells that were fixed prior to sorting was determined using previously validated cell-type specific methylation signals
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = genomic DNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = DNA was extracted using the DNeasy Blood and Tissue kit (#69504 Qiagen; Germantown, MD) according to the manufacturerâs instructions, and stored at -20Â°C for bisulfite conversion and whole genome sequencing.
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.
!Sample_data_processing = Paired-end FASTQ files were mapped to the human (hg19 -or- hg38), lambda, pUC19 and viral genomes using bwa-meth (V 0.2.0), with default parameters (Pedersen et al., 2014), then converted to BAM files using SAMtools (V 1.9) (Li et al., 2009).
!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were stripped from non-CpG nucleotides and converted to BETA files using wgbstools (V 0.2.0) (Loyfer and Kaplan).
!Sample_data_processing = Genome_build: hg19
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary_files_format_and_content:
!Sample_data_processing = beta files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = bigwig files were generated from beta files using wgbstools beta2bw with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = blocks file (bed) was generated using wgbstools segment, and then compressed and indexed using tabix (samtools)

Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.

!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).

!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.
!Sample_data_processing = Paired-end FASTQ files were mapped to the human (hg19 -or- hg38), lambda, pUC19 and viral genomes using bwa-meth (V 0.2.0), with default parameters (Pedersen et al., 2014), then converted to BAM files using SAMtools (V 1.9) (Li et al., 2009).
!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were stripped from non-CpG nucleotides and converted to BETA files using wgbstools (V 0.2.0) (Loyfer and Kaplan).
!Sample_data_processing = Genome_build: hg19
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary_files_format_and_content:
!Sample_data_processing = beta files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = bigwig files were generated from beta files using wgbstools beta2bw with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = blocks file (bed) was generated using wgbstools segment, and then compressed and indexed using tabix (samtools)

!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.
!Sample_data_processing = Paired-end FASTQ files were mapped to the human (hg19 -or- hg38), lambda, pUC19 and viral genomes using bwa-meth (V 0.2.0), with default parameters (Pedersen et al., 2014), then converted to BAM files using SAMtools (V 1.9) (Li et al., 2009).
!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were stripped from non-CpG nucleotides and converted to BETA files using wgbstools (V 0.2.0) (Loyfer and Kaplan).
!Sample_data_processing = Genome_build: hg19
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary_files_format_and_content:
!Sample_data_processing = beta files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = bigwig files were generated from beta files using wgbstools beta2bw with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = blocks file (bed) was generated using wgbstools segment, and then compressed and indexed using tabix (samtools)

!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared gDNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research; Irvine, CA), with liquid handling on a Hamilton MicroLab STAR (Hamilton; Reno, NV). Dual indexed sequencing libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library preparation kits (Swift BioSciences; Ann Arbor, MI) and custom liquid handling scripts executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa Biosystems; Wilmington, MA). Four uniquely dual indexed libraries, along with 10% PhiX v3 library (Illumina; San Diego, CA), were pooled and clustered on a Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150-bp paired-end sequencing.
!Sample_data_processing = Paired-end FASTQ files were mapped to the human (hg19 -or- hg38), lambda, pUC19 and viral genomes using bwa-meth (V 0.2.0), with default parameters (Pedersen et al., 2014), then converted to BAM files using SAMtools (V 1.9) (Li et al., 2009).
!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were stripped from non-CpG nucleotides and converted to BETA files using wgbstools (V 0.2.0) (Loyfer and Kaplan).
!Sample_data_processing = Genome_build: hg19
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary_files_format_and_content:
!Sample_data_processing = beta files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = bigwig files were generated from beta files using wgbstools beta2bw with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = blocks file (bed) was generated using wgbstools segment, and then compressed and indexed using tabix (samtools)

!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = Fresh tissue obtained at the time of surgery was trimmed to remove extraneous tissue. !Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Dual-indexed sequencing  libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library  preparation kits (Swift BioSciences) and custom liquid handling scripts  executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified  using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa  Biosystems). Four uniquely dual-indexed libraries, along with the 10%  PhiX v.3 library (Illumina), were pooled and clustered on an Illumina  NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150 bp, paired-end sequencing.
!Sample_description = CNVS-NORM-110036138-cfDNA-WGBS-Rep1
!Sample_data_processing = Paired-end FASTQ files were mapped to the human (hg19), lambda, pUC19 and viral genomes using bwa-meth (V 0.2.0), with default parameters (Pedersen et al., 2014), then converted to BAM files using SAMtools (V 1.9) (Li et al., 2009).
!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were stripped from non-CpG nucleotides and converted to BETA files using wgbstools (V 0.1.0) (Loyfer and Kaplan).
!Sample_data_processing = Assembly: hg19
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary files format and content: pat files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary files format and content: csi files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary files format and content: beta files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary files format and content: bigwig files were generated from beta files using wgbstools beta2bw with default parameteres

!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Up to 75 ng of sheared genomic DNA was subjected to bisulfite conversion  using the EZ-96 DNA Methylation Kit (Zymo Research), with  liquid handling on a MicroLab STAR (Hamilton).
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Dual-indexed sequencing  libraries were prepared using Accel-NGS Methyl-Seq DNA library  preparation kits (Swift BioSciences) and custom liquid handling scripts  executed on the Hamilton MicroLab STAR. Libraries were quantified  using KAPA Library Quantification Kits for Illumina Platforms (Kapa  Biosystems). Four uniquely dual-indexed libraries, along with the 10%  PhiX v.3 library (Illumina), were pooled and clustered on an Illumina  NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell followed by 150 bp, paired-end sequencing.
!Sample_description = CNVS-NORM-110036152-WBC-WGBS-Rep1
!Sample_data_processing = Paired-end FASTQ files were mapped to the human (hg19), lambda, pUC19 and viral genomes using bwa-meth (V 0.2.0), with default parameters (Pedersen et al., 2014), then converted to BAM files using SAMtools (V 1.9) (Li et al., 2009).
!Sample_data_processing = Duplicated reads were marked by Sambamba (V 0.6.5), with parameters â-l 1 -t 16 --sort-buffer-size 16000 --overflow-list-size 10000000â (Tarasov et al., 2015).
!Sample_data_processing = Reads with low mapping quality, duplicated, or not mapped in a proper pair were excluded using SAMtools view with parameters -F 1796 -q 10.
!Sample_data_processing = Reads were stripped from non-CpG nucleotides and converted to BETA files using wgbstools (V 0.1.0) (Loyfer and Kaplan).
!Sample_data_processing = Assembly: hg19
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary files format and content: pat files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary files format and content: csi files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary files format and content: beta files were generated using wgbstools (https://github.com/nloyfer/wgbs_tools) with default parameteres
!Sample_data_processing = Supplementary files format and content: bigwig files were generated from beta files using wgbstools beta2bw with default parameteres
